messages.agents.title: Agents
messages.consent.title: Install Claude Agent SDK
messages.consent.body: This board downloads @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.302 from registry.npmjs.org after you accept. Use is subject to Anthropic's legal agreements. The installed claude CLI and its existing login are required. The SDK is stored in your Persephone user data, not in this board.
messages.cli.required: Install the Claude or Codex CLI and sign in before starting a session.
messages.permissions: Trust grants this board a background service and App scripting. Sessions started here run in Auto mode, which asks in the chat about anything its classifier cannot approve; pick Bypass or Plan on the mode chip instead. In Bypass, Claude edits files, runs commands, and fully controls Persephone through its private MCP endpoint without asking.
messages.settings: Provider settings are managed in Settings → Editors → Agent Chat.
messages.startHint: Choose a working directory, then type your first message below to start the session. The session is named after your first words; rename it any time.
messages.noFolderHint: These sessions have no messages, so they record no working directory.
messages.consentRequired: Accept the SDK download before starting a Claude session.
